title: Henselian reduction preserves and reflects w-strict locality
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $(A,I)$ is a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. A commutative ring $B$ is w-strictly local [sk-def-pe-wlocal] when the set of closed points of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ is closed, every point specializes to exactly one closed point, and every localization $B_{\mathfrak m}$ at a maximal ideal is strictly henselian. Then $A$ is w-strictly local if and only if $A/I$ is w-strictly local.

source.place: Lemma 2.2.13, with the local-ring characterization in Lemma 2.2.9

proof.text: For the forward implication, the quotient map gives a closed embedding of spectra, hence w-locality descends by IsWLocalRing.of_surjective. For a maximal ideal m of A/I, put p=q^{-1}(m), S=A_p and J=IS. The quotient-localization instance and map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective identify S/J with (A/I)_m. The maximal ideal of S contracts to p, so J lies in it. Apply the strictly henselian quotient theorem and transfer strict henselianity across IsLocalization.algEquiv.

For the converse, HenselianRing.jac directly puts I in every maximal ideal. The closed quotient-spectrum embedding therefore maps the closed points of A/I bijectively onto those of A; its closed-map property makes the latter set closed. For p in Spec A, the given connectedSpace_zeroLocus_sup_of_henselian makes V(p+I) connected. The quotient-spectrum embedding identifies it with V(p(A/I)). Its continuous image in ConnectedComponents(Spec(A/I)) is preconnected and hence a singleton, since that space is totally disconnected. Closed-point injectivity into connected components in a w-local space (the proved WLocalSpace.closedPoints_eq_of_mk_eq) makes any two maximal ideals above p equal. This supplies the WLocalSpace structure on Spec A.

Prove the section construction for an arbitrary faithfully flat etale C-algebra D with C w-strictly local. At every maximal ideal m of C, form C_m tensor_C D. The ring base-change instances make this etale and faithfully flat over C_m. Spectrum surjectivity gives a point over its closed point. The strictly henselian etale-neighbourhood section theorem gives a section; Spec.preimage turns it into a C-algebra map D to C_m.

Finite presentation spreads each stalk map through a principal localization C_f with f outside m. On the profinite closed-point space, Mathlib IsOpenCover.exists_finite_nonempty_disjoint_clopen_cover refines these principal opens to a finite disjoint clopen cover. Apply wLocal_clopen_partition_properties to extend that partition to Spec C. If a point lies in an extended part, its closed specialization lies in that part and therefore in the selected principal open; openness puts the original point in it too. Factor each part inclusion through the localization open immersion, compose with Spec of its algebra map, and glue with the coproduct universal property nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of. The composite with Spec D to Spec C restricts to each inclusion, so hom_ext makes it the identity. Applying Spec.preimage gives a C-algebra retraction D to C.

For any etale A-algebra B surjective on spectra, flatness and Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective give faithful flatness. Base change to R=A/I and apply the preceding section construction to R tensor_A B. Compose with includeRight to obtain an A-algebra map B to R. Etale implies smooth, so exists_lift_of_henselianRing lifts it to an A-algebra map B to A. Its algebra-map equation is exactly a ring retraction.

Apply localization_atPrime_of_forall_retraction to these retractions. It gives strictly henselian maximal localizations of A. Combine with the WLocalSpace structure already proved to construct IsWStrictlyLocalRing A.
